REQUIREMENTS AND APPLICATION

NHS Process for New Member Selection:

  • All members must be a junior or senior.
  • 3.5 unweighted cumulative GPA as of June 2022.
  • Must be enrolled in at least 4 academic courses each trimester.
  • Behavior in good standing.
  • $20 membership fee due upon acceptance.
  • 10 hours (reduced from 20) of independent community service completed and documented by the application deadline of Friday, September 30th.  Service hours must have been completed from January 2022 to September 30th, 2022
  • Completion of the application and turned in by 3:45pm on Friday, September 30th, 2022.  Applications will be available in the main office when school begins. All applications will be screened and evaluated by a five member faculty committee and official notification of acceptance will be by October 24th via email.

SERVICE OPPORTUNITIES
Please check back for service opportunities.

TUTORING
Please check back for tutoring opportunities.
